listing.name: Sonic and the Black Knight — BlackKnightRecomp (yunophilia)
listing.summary: The project reports startup and gameplay. Proton 9 and Experimental tests used software Vulkan only; Steam Deck play is untested. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA RENE8P, Europe RENP8P or Japan RENJ8P disc in ISO, RVZ, WIA or WBFS form. The first extraction needs about 3.5 GB.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: The release executable includes the translated game code; follow its installer instructions with your own disc data. The installer retains the extracted data. Building from source is a separate route that reads your own discs.

warnings: The project reports startup and gameplay. Proton 9 and Experimental tests used software Vulkan only; Steam Deck play is untested.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
